text:
You’re not undoing your recovery. Three pizza nights do not erase weeks of healing. What matters most is the average over time, and right now the job is simply: keep your body well fed.

Do this next:

| Next step | What to do |
|---|---|
| Next meal | Normal balanced meal: protein + carb + veg/fruit |
| Today | Aim for regular meals, not “making up for it” by starving |
| Protein | Include a solid protein source 3–4 times today |
| Bone support | Keep calcium-rich foods in the day: dairy/fortified milk/yogurt, tofu, greens |
| Hydration | Drink water normally; no need to punish yourself |
| Mindset | Pizza is food, not failure |

If you want, I can turn this into a simple 1-day recovery meal plan in metric that keeps things easy and low-stress.

attributes.reason: The tone is gentle and reassuring, not pushy or intense.
It centers recovery, reassurance, and getting back to normal eating rather than performance.
It uses a clear table and even references metric, matching the requested table-based format.
